Retain the Tibetan-angle full nominal 'du shes/ability to conceptualize and expand the English-angle conceptualize-only proposal. Original HGM 9528 includes conceptualize but also conception/discrimination; local 'du shes is the cognitive faculty which dissolves, not an independently asserted action. Original C05:51 has 'du shes mi gsal pa with ability to discriminate ... too unclear, supporting the nominal faculty construction; ILL:2332 instead says conception ... dissolved completely, useful contrary phrasing. Ability to makes the verb an English nominal faculty expression; their remains supplied. No claim that 'du shes alone denotes general ability, no d7 ability member, and no hgm_gloss alteration.
